messages.content: What's a "custom request" in creator terms?

Basically it's personalized content a fan pays extra for - something made to their specific ask, whether that's a video, photo set, or message, instead of the usual posted-for-everyone stuff. Worth setting your own boundaries early, sotti bolte, on what you will and won't take requests for.
